text:
joel: Heads-up: we need a decision on breadcrumb content and permalink behavior before the console release next week. Two main questions: should breadcrumbs show cluster labels (eg. Projects/Models) or only app-level sections? And how should permalinks encode cluster context?
anya: My vote: breadcrumbs should include cluster -> section -> item. It helps orient users when the left rail is collapsed. Example: Projects > Pipelines > run-42.
kevin: If we include cluster in breadcrumbs we must ensure names match the rail copy exactly. We had confusion when rail used "Apps" but breadcrumbs said "Projects". That mismatch is worse than either naming.
priya: Accessibility: breadcrumbs need role="navigation" and an aria-label like "Breadcrumb". Each crumb that is a link should have meaningful text; truncated ids should have title attributes. Also ensure keyboard users can open intermediate crumbs in new tabs (cmd/ctrl+enter).
joel: Agree on aria-label. Also think about permalink format: current is /ws/:id/models/:mid. Proposal A: keep that shallow. Proposal B: canonicalize to /ws/:id/cluster:models/asset/:mid so the cluster is explicit for routing across workspaces.
kevin: Proposal B is safer for routing but will break some existing links. If we adopt B, we should add 301 redirects and a compatibility layer for old permalinks.
anya: Small UX idea: show a faint cluster chip to the left of the breadcrumb so users immediately see cluster context without adding another crumb. Chip can be visually hidden for SRs but present in breadcrumb structure.
priya: Good microcopy point: chip label must be the same as nav text. Also ensure the chip has aria-hidden="true" if it's decorative and the same info is in the breadcrumb list for assistive tech.
joel: Edge-case: when a permalink references a resource from another workspace (eg. asset id exists only in ws-7 but user is in ws-3). Behavior options: 1) show a banner and stay on hub, 2) prompt workspace switch modal, 3) route to a cross-workspace preview if allowed. Which do we prefer?
anke: I prefer non-blocking behavior: show a banner (1) with an action to switch workspace. Prompting modal is disruptive.
kevin: Dev note: we'll implement a resolver that tries to find a matching resource in current workspace first, then falls back. Also add a telemetry event when fallback occurs.
anya: Accessibility nit: when banner appears, focus must not be stolen from top of page unexpectedly. Banner should be tabbable and announced by SR as "Notice: linked resource not found in this workspace."
priya: Also add a visible keyboard focus style on breadcrumb links in compact rail mode. We had failures in keyboard-only tests where focus was too subtle.
joel: UX trade: compact rail + persistent cluster chip vs full breadcrumb cluster crumb. Which to ship? Suggest A/B test: chip vs crumb in two cohorts.
kevin: A/B test ok but keep routing identical across cohorts. Only change is visual breadcrumb/rail.
anya: I'll draft copy for the banner (2 variants): Variant 1: "This link points to a resource outside your current workspace. Showing the [Models] hub instead." Variant 2: "We couldn't find the linked item here. Try switching workspaces or search."
priya: I'll add ARIA checklist and focus-ring tests to the PR. Also include screen-reader announcement examples for the banner.
joel: Action items: Kevin -> compat redirect layer + resolver. Anya -> craft banner copy and run quick microtest. Priya -> ARIA/focus tests. I'll schedule a 15-min sync at 11:00 PT to confirm. ux-bot: [reminder] sync scheduled 2491238100.
